content: The CARE (Cholesterol and Recurrent Events) trial aimed to determine whether the administration of pravastatin could reduce the combined incidence of fatal coronary artery disease (CAD) and nonfatal myocardial infarction (MI) in patients who had previously experienced a myocardial infarction and had a total cholesterol level of less than 240 mg/dL. This study was designed as a double-blinded, randomized clinical trial. A total of 4,159 patients with a documented history of myocardial infarction within the preceding two years and a total cholesterol level below 240 mg/dL were enrolled. Participants were randomly assigned to receive either 40 mg of pravastatin daily or a placebo.
